verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents product tax codes (PTCs) that associate products with tax rates, with a preset default PTC for products that lack one. Rates are determined by product type plus customer and business location, and results are explained via `taxability_reason` and itemized line-item exports, so per-line-item taxation by product type is clearly the core design. Coverage is limited to a documented list of supported locations, and the evidence never enumerates the specific categories (SaaS, digital goods, services, physical goods). Missing for 10: an explicit catalog of tax categories covering SaaS, digital goods, services and physical products; evidence that coverage spans every jurisdiction rather than a supported-locations list; independent or hands-on corroboration of PTC mapping accuracy.
